severity_challenge: Impact is smaller than HIGH implies. Every LOCAL artist in the dev DB has mbid IS NULL (4,002/4,002), and upsert_musicbrainz_artist flips origin to 'musicbrainz' when an MBID arrives, so the delete only removes MBID-less artists. With the row present, real_mbid=None and the strategy goes straight to Step C (name fallback). With the row deleted, Step A misses, Step B makes one wasted MB search with arid=<local uuid> (cached afterwards; mb_client.py:281), then Step C runs anyway. The matching result is the same. The remaining harm is a dangling matches.target_id (the review UI cannot resolve the artist name) plus one extra rate-limited MB call per (artist, title), until a perform_reset rematch. Suggest MEDIUM. The fix and the characterisation test still stand.
would_change_verdict: Code other than ResolvedArtistMbidStrategy that needs matches.target_id to resolve to an artists row (e.g. an INNER JOIN in a matching/queue read) would make the impact user-visible and support HIGH. None found in routers/matching.py:630-680; that path was not searched exhaustively.
